rationale: B1.3-C10 owns chemical composition, chemical reactions, pollutant/process chemistry; B1.4-C01 owns Earth-context mineral/rock/geochemical reservoirs, geological histories and Earth-system interpretation. Accepted C10 claims/objectives were re-audited for semantic duplicate/ownership separation; identical chemistry meaning is not re-authored as C01 ownership.
B1.2 retains transferable physical laws and generic measurement theory; B1.4-C03 owns Earth-specific geophysical observation, inversion and interpretation.
